title: iOS-Style Drag Over Tabs Gesture & Enhanced Haptic Detents
summary: Adds native iOS-style smooth touch drag-over gestures across tabs on mobile devices with live thumb tracking and crisp tactile detent feedback on tab transitions.

changes.text: iOS-Style Drag-to-Switch Gesture: touch down and drag smoothly across the mobile bottom navigation dock to preview and switch destinations in real time with continuous thumb tracking and elastic snap physics.
Tactile Detent Haptic Feedback: added ultra-crisp micro-ticks (dragTick) when crossing tab boundaries and a satisfying double-pulse snap confirmation (dragSnap) on touch release.
Segmented Tab Dragging: brought the same fluid drag-over tab selection to the scanner mode segmented controls (ScannerTabs) on touch screens.
